thread:
olivia: FYI customer asked for an explicit key handover schedule and whether BYO-CMK affects billing. sending to SE + security for runbook.
ben (SE): noted. do they want CloudHSM or an HSM-backed KMS proxy? which clouds are in scope?
maria (Legal): also need a short statement for the data room about who holds the key material and the indemnity language. can we provide a standard clause?
raj (Security): we can provide a template runbook for key ceremony + rotation windows. question: do they require dual-control key ceremony or just automated rotation via KMS API?
olivia: they mentioned regulated fintech — prefer HSM-backed CMKs with dual-control during initial onboarding. later rotations can be automated with role separation.
ben (SE): ok. for AWS CloudHSM we map CMK->CustomerKey in our connector. we should document network peering, latency, and a small terraform snippet for provisioning. pinging alex-billing on pricing.
alex-billing: billing note — BYO-HSM connector is treated as an add-on: one-time onboarding fee + monthly connector charge. if we do key escrow or key escrow rotation ops, that's a separate SOW line item.
olivia: can you draft numbers? they asked for an estimate to include in the PO.
alex-billing: ballpark: $12k onboarding + $2k/month for connector + $1k/month for key-ops support (optional). I'll draft a more formal quote once SE confirms expected call volume (requests/sec).
ben (SE): request volume will affect throughput and whether we need dedicated encryption proxies. can we get an estimate from the customer? I'll ask.
maria (Legal): for the data room we can provide this short clause: "Customer retains sole ownership of CMKs; Redwood will not export plaintext key material. Root key material remains in customer HSM under customer control." need approval from Security.
raj (Security): clause is fine but add: "Redwood will provide audit logs of all key usage and support key rotation per agreed schedule; access to key material requires documented key ceremony and dual-authorization." also: require KMS audit log retention 1 year (or configurable).
ben (SE): adding runbook checklist for infra team:
```text
- Network: VPC peering, firewall rules to HSM endpoints
- Auth: service account with least privilege, MFA for handovers
- Provision: CloudHSM cluster creation (if aws), import key material flow
- Ops: rotation schedule, rollback plan, runbook owner
- Monitoring: KMS usage logs -> centralized SIEM
```
olivia: perfect. can we attach the runbook & the quote to the data room by EOD? customer expects legal + procurement review tomorrow.
alex-billing: I can push the quote to the shared drive now.
ben (SE): i'll upload the runbook draft in ~30m. one open technical Q: do we support ephemeral wrapping keys for inference cache encryption (so we don't need to call KMS every token)?
raj (Security): we support encrypting dataset/KV caches with a derived per-host key wrapped by CMK. that reduces call volume; include in ops notes that unwrap rate limits exist.
olivia: thanks all. maria, can you confirm the template clause? if legal sign-off, i'll add to data room and follow up in the call with the customer's security team.
maria (Legal): will review and sign off by 15:30 PT. adding a minor edit on indemnity paragraph.
security-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 artifact link to data room: https://redwood.internal/soc2/2024
olivia: added. next: SE -> schedule a 30m runbook walkthrough with customer's infosec. proposed slots tomorrow 10a or 3p PT.
ben (SE): putting 10a on my calendar. will include a short demo of CloudHSM connector and the rotation automation flow.
olivia: thanks team — i'll update the deal tracker and loop in solutions-architect if anything else comes up. :thumbsup:
